title: The gender gap in highly prestigious international research awards, 2001-2020
url_used: https://scholarworks.aub.edu.lb/items/18d28692-a53d-4e17-909b-d17a78f3a265 (AUB ScholarWorks; publisher PDF at direct.mit.edu and CORE copy both Cloudflare-blocked)
notes: Key number: MATCH. Abstract: 3,445 awards to 2,011 men and 262 women (262/2,273 = 11.5% of recipients); women's share rose from 6% (2001-05) to 19% (2016-20). Fig 2: 6%, 9%, 11%, 19% by 5-year bin.
